name: Rural Financial Literacy, KCC & Banking Guidance
overview: Information on institutional credit, Kisan Credit Cards, interest subvention schemes, Self-Help Groups (SHGs), and safe banking practices to prevent rural predatory lending.

kcc_features.normal_interest_rate: 7.0% per annum for loans up to ₹3 Lakh
kcc_features.interest_subvention: 3.0% additional interest subvention for prompt repayment
kcc_features.collateral_free_limit: Up to ₹1.60 Lakh without collateral / mortgage (up to ₹3 Lakh under PACS tie-up)
kcc_features.validity: 5 years with annual review and progressive limit increase

shg_linkage.collateral_free_loans: Up to ₹10 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh for eligible women SHGs under DAY-NRLM.

fraud_prevention: Never share OTP, ATM PIN, or Aadhaar biometric authentication with unknown agents.
Always demand printed computerized POS receipt for fertilizer purchases and loan repayments.
Report fraudulent loan deductions to the Banking Ombudsman (RBI Helpline: 14448).
